items.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: it’s got to be like Chicago school or it’s got to be Oliver- Armstrong-Hardin thing

ctx.x: With the exception of one player at this particular festival. And it seems to be the case. The only difference I’ve seen was a jazz cruise that I went on once, and I don’t know, do you have an indication of why that’s happened?

That’s a very complicated issue. I think it has something to do with the stratification of this music. You know it’s like an oreo cookie that people are always trying to take apart and just get at one layer of it somehow. You know there’s so many different factions and different camps, and well there’s got to be classic jazz, and well how do we define that, well it’s got to be this or that, it’s got to be like Chicago school or it’s got to be Oliver- Armstrong-Hardin thing or the Austin High gang, or it’s got to…
Yeah, I know what you mean.
